mapper.select: SELECT approval_reference FROM audit_archive_expiry_grant WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND effective_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE

SELECT hold_id FROM audit_archive_hold WHERE scope_type=#{scope.type} AND tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND released_at IS NULL AND (resource_id IS NULL OR JSON_CONTAINS(#{resources}, JSON_QUOTE(resource_id))) FOR UPDATE
SELECT ticket_id FROM audit_archive_restore_grant WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_archive_restored WHERE batch_id=#{id} LIMIT 200
DELETE FROM audit_archive_late_evidence WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND id<=#{lastId} LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_archive_expiry_receipt SET confirmed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND confirmed_at IS NULL
UPDATE audit_archive_expiry_receipt SET confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt} WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND confirmed_at IS NULL
UPDATE audit_archive_batch SET state='EXPIRED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state='ONLINE_PURGED'
